scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Coaching- Haryana Labour Welfare Board
other_conditions: Applicant must be employed in an industrial or commercial establishment in Haryana.
Applicant must be registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.
Applicant's monthly salary must not exceed ₹25,000.
Applicant must have at least one year of service.
Benefits are for children of registered workers who are receiving coaching for entrance examinations in professional courses or preparing for UPSC/HPSC main examination after passing preliminary.
Child must have scored at least 60% marks in the qualifying examination.
Child must not be self‑employed or employed.
Child can also avail benefits if already receiving a scholarship from the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.
Scheme provides benefits to up to three girl children and two boy children per worker.
Coaching institute must have been providing coaching for at least three years.
Institute must have coached at least 300 students.
Institute must have been paying GST for at least three years.
Institute must have paid Labour Welfare Fund dues and be registered under the Shop & Commercial Establishment Act, 1958.
benefits_summary: Up to ₹20,000 (or 75% of the coaching fee, whichever is lower) for entrance‑exam coaching, and up to ₹1,00,000 for UPSC/HPSC main‑exam preparation.
